description: Vashya (Vasya) koota — mutual control / magnetic attraction between the two Moon rashis, scored via their vashya groups.

vashya_groups._comment: Five classical vashya groups. Names given with common English glosses.

scoring.rule: Look up the (groom_group, bride_group) pair in group_score_matrix. Diagonal (same group) = 2.

group_score_matrix._comment: rows/cols = vashya groups. Values 2/1/0.5/0. DRAFT: same-group=2 is certain; off-diagonal values are the most source-variable cells in the whole pack and MUST be verified. The classical canonical form is actually a 12x12 rashi-pair vashya table (each rashi 'controls' specific rashis); this 5x5 group reduction is a documented simplification pending review.

notes: Group assignments follow the widely-used simplified table. Ambiguous half-sign signs (Sagittarius, Capricorn) are assigned by the dominant half: Sagittarius=Manava(Dwipada), Capricorn=Jalachara. Cancer=Jalachara. Verify against the chosen authority.
review_required: the authoritative implementation should prefer the classical rashi-pair (12x12) vashya table; this group matrix is a stand-in until the source table is transcribed and cited.
